rows.title: Guardian Seal of the Grimoire
rows.subtitle: {planet} · {heaven} ({sephira}) — the book-curse: wards the grimoire; the curse wakes only against whoso reads unbidden
rows.correspondences: Square of {planet} (every line sums to {line_sum} — the number of Adonai — the whole square to {square_sum}). The Intelligence {intelligence} and Spirit {spirit}, each {square_sum}, are traced upon it. Sealed by {god_name}, god-name of {sephira}, under the archangel {archangel}; crowned by the Eye that reads the reader. The rim bears the conditional curse after the manner of the old book-anathemas, with the verse of the Sixth Pentacle of Mars: gladius eorum intret in corda ipsorum — “their own sword shall enter their own heart.”
rows.steps: Elect a {day} in an hour of {planet} (see Planetary Hours), Moon waning — the warding tide (see Moon & Timing). Print it, or copy it by hand in red or iron-gall ink, and fix it to the first leaf or inside the front cover of the grimoire. Write your name or personal mark in the owner’s cartouche — the guardian is bound to that name, and your leave is the key that lets a reader pass. Charge it in sharp smoke — dragon’s blood or black pepper — and state the condition aloud: the curse sleeps for all who enter by my leave; it wakes only against the trespasser. The curse is conditional, not aimed: it targets no one until someone makes themselves its target by trespass. When you lend the book, speak the permission aloud as you hand it over — the guardian hears its owner. To release: strike your name from the cartouche and burn or bury the plate with a word of thanks; the watch ends.

rows.title: Binding Seal of {planet}
rows.subtitle: {planet} · {heaven} — binds & returns hex, curse, and malice; wards the bearer
rows.correspondences: Square of {planet} (every line sums to {line_sum}, the whole square to {square_sum}). The Intelligence {intelligence} and Spirit {spirit} — both equal to {square_sum} — are traced upon it. Sealed by the divine name {god_name} of {sephira}, under the archangel {archangel}.
rows.steps: Elect a {day} in an hour of {planet} (see Planetary Hours), ideally while the Moon is waning or dark (the banishing tide — see Moon & Timing). Render it on black paper in silver ink, or engrave it on {metal} or pewter — {planet}’s metal. Printing the SVG is fine. Name aloud the harm you mean to bind and turn back. Bind the malice itself, not a person’s free soul — keep the intent defensive. Pass it through myrrh smoke to charge it. Seal the binding: wrap it in black thread and tie knots as you state the intent — three, or nine (3×3) for {planet}. To make it return-to-sender, stand a small mirror behind it, facing outward. Keep it wrapped in black cloth, or place it at a boundary — a threshold, or buried at the edge of your property. To release the working when it’s done: unknot the thread and burn or bury the seal with a word of thanks.

rows.title: Wealth Seal of {planet}
rows.subtitle: {planet} · {heaven} — draws increase, fortune, opportunity, and abundance
rows.correspondences: Square of {planet} (every line sums to {line_sum}, the whole square to {square_sum}). The Intelligence {intelligence} is traced upon it. Sealed by the god-name {god_name} ({god_name_hebrew}) of {sephira}, under the archangel {archangel}; its Spirit is {spirit}.
rows.steps: Elect a {day} in an hour of {planet} (see Planetary Hours), while the Moon is waxing — the growing tide for drawing and increase (see Moon & Timing). Render it on blue or royal-purple, or engrave it on {metal}. Printing the SVG is fine. Name clearly the increase you seek — the outcome, not another person’s loss. Charge it in cedar or frankincense smoke. Keep it where your money moves: in your wallet, your ledger, your safe, or your place of business. Renew it by re-charging on a following {day} in a {planet} hour; anoint with a drop of olive or cedar oil if you wish.
